e3_ceiling.aggregation: pooled precision of canary_shaped_strings against the gold oracle
e3_ceiling.population: The historical no-PAIR corpus of 26,854 outputs.

e3_track_range.aggregation: per-track pooled precision, then the range
e3_track_range.population: The ten precision-qualified model tracks in the historical no-PAIR corpus.

e4_ladder_drop.aggregation: prompt mean, then seed mean, then the range over tracks of the level 0 minus level 1 difference
e4_ladder_drop.population: the nine tracks carrying all five refusal levels, in-distribution prompts only

e4_post_l1_band.aggregation: prompt mean, then seed mean, then the widest max-minus-min across levels 1 to 4
e4_post_l1_band.population: the nine full-ladder tracks, levels 1 to 4, in-distribution prompts only

benign_examples.basis: Refusal counts are n_benign times the stored exact FRR=1. No response re-scoring.
32/32 is the manuscript-reported count, not independently replayed from metrics. Metrics supply FRR=1 only; n_attack is not the benign denominator.
